Locator: printed journal page (229-240) and table number. Four continuous biodiesel plant designs at 8000 t/yr: I alkali with virgin canola oil, II alkali with waste cooking oil and esterification pretreatment, III acid-catalyzed with waste oil, IV acid with hexane extraction (technology paper: Zhang et al. 2003a, Bioresource Technology 89, 1-16, not held). All US$, price year 2000 (CEPCI 394 for equipment; chemical prices Nov 2000 - 2001); the paper does not name a year for the totals so 2000 is taken from the equipment-cost update. Only case 1 (85 wt% glycerine, NRTL) is reported in detail; cases 2-4 differ insignificantly. Loaded per plant: capex (fixed capital cost), opex-total (total manufacturing cost net of glycerine credit), break-even price, electricity use, flows derived from printed cost/price pairs (rounding of $M costs limits precision, flagged in notes), and the methanol distillation column equipment cost (Table 3). Not loaded: sensitivity analysis (regression model, no technology numbers), literature plant costs other than other-values. Trap: Table 3 Process II lists two methanol columns in one cell; summed.
